system.concept: Ancient Gangrel berserker who hunts Cathayans in San Francisco's parks
system.biography:
Background

Born in Iceland in 835 CE, Mirko Mirkonen was Embraced by the ancient @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} warlord Stilgar the Reaver and spent a millennium seeking out wars across Europe, occasionally falling into torpor from his wounds only to emerge reinvigorated. Though only a nominal @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} supporter, his hatred of the patricidal @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} led him to help destroy a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} antitribu infiltrator near Chicago, earning him a declined offer of Archon status. He drifted west and now partners with fellow @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} Gustavo Morales, hunting lone Cathayans through San Francisco's parks.

Roleplaying Hints

Relaxed and easygoing outside of combat, Mirkonen transforms into a berserker in battle, living for conflict and taking pride in his ability to both deal and withstand enormous damage. He and Morales are folk heroes among the city's Kindred for reclaiming the parks and the Richmond district from Kuei-jin control.
system.notes: Sire: Stilgar the Reaver. Partner: Gustavo Morales. Disciplines (as printed): Animalism 5, Fortitude 5, Obfuscate 2, Potence 5, Protean 4. Develops a taste for Cathayan blood, which he suspects he may regret.

system.description: You have become a walking juggernaut. You may perform a Simple Test to negate aggravated wounds, conducting one test per wound level incurred. If you win, you take no damage; on a tie the wound becomes nonaggravated. You cannot continue testing down with Imperviousness after a successful test on Invulnerability.

Spend a Willpower Trait and mark the target with a drop of vitae, then spend one Blood Trait per level of Fortitude you wish to grant and win a Static Physical Challenge against three times the Blood Traits spent. Success bestows that many levels of Fortitude on the target for the rest of the night (only the net increase counts if they already have some); failure allows a Survival retest. Only one instance of this power may be active on a given target at a time.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait per level of Fortitude granted, per target
system.retestAbility: One Willpower Trait, plus Survival for retest

system.description: Functions exactly as Personal Armor, but you take no damage at all from weapons that shatter against you, rather than suffering the attack's normal damage first.

Facetiously named, this power allows the Kindred to physically knock another character away from herself with the slightest of touches. Although this power does no damage in and of itself, its use is quite humbling — to be hurled away from an elder in a social setting has its embarrassing repercussions. Some Kindred use this power surreptitiously, touching their victims and sending them reeling across the room; others use it as a not-so-subtle display of their might, giving their victim a casual slap with overwhelming results.

System: The player spends a Blood Trait and must succeed in a physical challenge to touch the target (this may be done surreptitiously, but the player may not make use of other Potence benefits). The challenge is not required if the subject allows the player to touch him (a handshake, a “friendly” hand on the shoulder, etc). This power hurls the victim 20 feet directly away from the invoking character. If the subject strikes a wall or other solid obstacle, he suffers two health levels of bashing damage. Otherwise, the character needs to win a static physical challenge against six Traits to remain standing.

A Brujah with this power can stir the hearts of his allies, granting them courage and strength for the cause they fight for. Once employed, those affected fight fearlessly and with great strength, following the Cainite into battle against even overwhelming odds.

System: The player rolls Strength + Intimidation (difficulty 7). Any opposing power meant to inspire fear or otherwise prevent an affected ally from fighting suffers +2 difficulty. All affected allies — mortal, ghoul, or Cainite — also gain one dot of Potence for the scene per two successes. The number of successes determines how many allies are affected, from a single person (1 success) up to every ally in the vampire's immediate vicinity, such as a courtyard or battle group (5 successes).
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots

system.description: You now possess power so colossal that only the suicidal or the insane would cross you in a test of strength. You are so dangerous in hand-to-hand combat that you inflict two additional wounds if you win the challenge. If your opponent uses Demolition, and each of you wins one of the tests, you both take full damage.

While many Kindred find the blood of animals revolting, you are able to reap unique benefits from this type of feeding. This power doubles the number of Blood Traits you may obtain from any single animal you feed from. It is not in effect when you feed on humans.

You may enter a controlled frenzy at will by winning or tying a Simple Test, choosing your own targets while the frenzy otherwise plays out normally; failure drops you into an uncontrolled frenzy instead. You may also regain composure during an uncontrolled frenzy with a Self-Control Challenge, spending a Willpower Trait each turn to hold onto that control until Willpower runs out or the frenzy is ended normally.

Functioning like Cowing the Beast but affecting groups of mortals you can see (no eye contact needed). Spend one Trait per target; each target must immediately flee, cannot use Willpower Traits, and receives the Negative Trait Submissive x2 for the rest of the night. Does not work on vampires.

items.name: Protean — 2 Intermediate — Shape of the Beast

system.description: By spending one to three Blood Traits over one to three turns, you transform into an animal form such as a wolf or bat, gaining its natural advantages and the use of most of your other Disciplines, until the next dawn or until you change back.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next dawn or you choose to revert

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait and a full turn, you sink into raw soil, becoming undetectable and immune to daylight while you sleep undisturbed, rising again at will or if the soil is disturbed.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines

vtmlarp.source: San Francisco by Night, Chapter Five: Honored Shen
